# R data loading

```{r}
data_t0t1 <- readRDS(here::here(
  "mpx",
  "rdata",
  "robj_suzuki_cart_processed_data_t0t1.rds"
))
#"/Volumes/T7/customer_analyses/suzuki/rdata/robj_suzuki_cart_processed_data_t0t1.rds")

pxl_paths <- list.files(
  here::here("mpx", "data"),
  pattern = "*.pxl",
  full.names = TRUE
)
#"/Volumes/T7/customer_analyses/suzuki/data"

# update paths
FSMap(data_t0t1) <- pixelatorR::FSMap(data_t0t1) |>
  mutate(
    path = pxl_paths[match(
      basename(FSMap(data_t0t1)$pxl_file),
      basename(pxl_paths)
    )]
  ) |>
  select(-pxl_file) |>
  rename(pxl_file = path)
```

- [x] 3B.2. Use the same colors as in the RNAseq for UMAP

NOTE: The colors for CART+ cells are very similar between CD4 and CD8!

```{r}
#| label: rnaseq-color-theme
#| code-fold: true
rna_palette <- c(
  "CD4 T" = "#4968D9",
  "CD8 T" = "#AD5BCD",

  "CD4 T FMC63+" = "#161B6E",
  # "CD8 T FMC63hi" = "#1B7E6F",
  "CD8 T FMC63+" = "#4A0180",
  "Other T" = "#1B7E9F",
  "NK" = "#F9D849",
  "Myeloid" = "#CD7692",
  "Platelets" = "#797979"
)

pal_donor <- c(
  "#7B98C1",
  "#C7A989",
  "#CB73A8"
)


pal_patient <- c(
  "Patient 1" = "#7B98C1",
  "Patient 2" = "#C7A989",
  "Patient 3" = "#CB73A8"
)

pal_org_bl <- c("#053061", "white", "#670020")

colors <- c(
  "#053061",
  "#2166AC",
  "#4393C3",
  "#92C5DE",
  "#D1E5F0",
  "#F7F7F7",
  "#FDDBC7",
  "#F4A582",
  "#D6604D",
  "#B2182B",
  "#67001F"
)

  colorRampPalette(
    c("gray90", "#FFE0EA", "#E9AABF", "#CD6F8D", "#A23F5E", "#781534")
```

```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=5}
pt_size <- 0.5

# This figure uses a different seurat object

#   "/Volumes/T7/customer_analyses/suzuki/rdata/robj_suzuki_cart_processed_data_all.rds"

  "mpx",
  "rdata",
  "robj_suzuki_cart_processed_data_all.rds"
))

p1 <- DimPlot(
  object = data_t0t1 |> subset(type == "CAR-T_product"),

p2 <- DimPlot(
  object = data_t0t1 |> subset(type == "CAR-T_product"),
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = "FMC63_status_clr",
  cols = fmc_status_col,
  pt.size = pt_size
) +
  labs(title = "FMC63 status") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", aspect.ratio = 1)

p3 <- DimPlot(
  object = data_t0t1 |> subset(type == "CAR-T_product"),

p <- wrap_plots(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)
```

## panel D: cell fractions

```{r}
data_t0t1[[]] |>
  filter(celltype != "Platelets") |>
  select(donor, celltype, timepoint) |>
  filter(
    celltype %in%
      c("CD4 T", "CD4 T FMC63+", "CD8 T", "CD8 T FMC63+", "NK", "Other T")
  ) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    .by = c(donor, celltype, timepoint)
  ) |>
  readr::write_csv(here("mpx", "cell_counts.csv"))

cell_fraction_plot <- pixelatorR::CellCountPlot(
  data_t0t1 |> subset(timepoint == "t0" & celltype != "Platelets"),
  group_by = "donor",
  color_by = "cluster_annotated_fmc",
  stack = TRUE,
  as_frequency = TRUE
)

cell_fraction_data <- cell_fraction_plot$data |>
  mutate(
    donor = case_when(
      donor == "donor_32" ~ "Patient 1",
      donor == "donor_44" ~ "Patient 2",
      donor == "donor_50" ~ "Patient 3"
    ),
    frequency = frequency / 100,
  )

final_plot <- ggplot(
  cell_fraction_data,
  aes(x = donor, y = frequency, fill = cluster_annotated_fmc)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rna_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Frequency", fill = NULL)

final_plot

ggsave2(
  filename = here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "3D.pdf"),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  scale = 1.5
)
```

## panel F: heatmap

- [x] Add marker selection criteria

A protein should be detected in at least 2 samples and have a mean abundance of at least 0.5 in at least 2 samples (per cell type).

```{r}
DefaultAssay(data_t0t1) <- "mpxCells"
data_t0t1@meta.data <- data_t0t1@meta.data |>
  mutate(
    patient = case_when(
      donor == "donor_32" ~ "Patient 1",
      donor == "donor_44" ~ "Patient 2",
      donor == "donor_50" ~ "Patient 3"
    )
  )
samples_plot <- data_t0t1@meta.data |>
  filter(timepoint == "t0") |>
  pull(sample) |>
  unique()
ct_1 <- "CD8 T FMC63+"
ct_2 <- "CD8 T"
```

```{r}
#| label: marker-selection-criteria

selected_markers <- FilterMarkers(
  data_t0t1 |> subset(timepoint == "t0"),
  threshold = 0.5,
  min_samples = 1,
  min_percent = 0.1,
  sample_col = "sample",
  group_vars = "celltype",
  layer = "data",
  return_stats = FALSE
)

markers_selected <- unique(unlist(selected_markers[c(3, 4)]))
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
fetch_abundance <- function(ct_label) {
  data_t0t1 %>%
    subset(cluster_annotated_fmc == ct_label & sample %in% samples_plot) |>
    FetchData(
      vars = c("patient", markers_selected),
      assay = "mpxCells",
      layer = "data"
    ) %>%
    group_by(patient) %>%
    summarise_at(c(markers_selected), mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(celltype = ct_label)
}

abundance_combined <- bind_rows(
  fetch_abundance(ct_1),
  fetch_abundance(ct_2)
)

mat <- abundance_combined[, c("patient", "celltype", markers_selected)] |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  unite("row_id", patient, celltype, sep = " | ", remove = TRUE) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

ct_split <- abundance_combined$celltype
patient_split <- abundance_combined$patient

ct_colors <- c(ct_1 = "#4A0180", ct_2 = "#AD5BCD")
names(ct_colors) <- c(ct_1, ct_2)

row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
  `Cell type` = ct_split,
  `Patient` = patient_split,
  col = list(
    `Cell type` = ct_colors,
    `Patient` = pal_patient
  ),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  annotation_name_rot = 45,
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

lims <- c(0, 5)
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(lims[1], lims[2], length.out = 100),
  retro_palette(100)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Abundance\n(CLR)",
  col = col_fun,
  row_split = ct_split,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  column_dend_height = unit(15, "mm"),
  left_annotation = row_ann,
  row_title = NULL,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  # row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  width = unit(1, "snpc"),
  height = unit(0.15, "snpc"),
  column_title = "Protein abundance in CD8 T cells (t0)",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold")
)

draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)

pdf(here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "3F.pdf"), width = 12)
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()


png(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "3F.png"),
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  res = 200
)
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```

# Figure 4

## panel A

```{r}
#| label: fmc63-polarity

pol_scores <- PolarizationScores(data_t0t1) |>
  left_join(
    data_t0t1@meta.data |>
      select(component, celltype, patient, timepoint),
    by = "component"
  ) |>
  filter(marker %in% selected_markers[["CD8 T FMC63+"]]) |>
  group_by(celltype, patient, marker, timepoint) |>
  summarise(morans_z = mean(morans_z, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pol_mat <- pol_scores |>
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+", timepoint == "t0") |>
  unite("row_id", patient, sep = " | ") |>
  select(row_id, marker, morans_z) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = morans_z) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

pol_mat[is.na(pol_mat)] <- 0

row_meta <- pol_scores |>
  select(patient) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(patient)

pol_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(0, 6, length.out = 100),
  cherry_gradient(100)
)

pol_row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
  `Patient` = row_meta$patient,
  col = list(
    `Patient` = pal_patient
  ),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

ht_pol <- Heatmap(
  pol_mat,
  name = "Polarity\n(Moran's Z)",
  col = pol_col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  column_dend_height = unit(15, "mm"),
  # left_annotation  = pol_row_ann,
  row_title = NULL,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  row_names_side = "left",
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  width = ncol(pol_mat) * unit(5, "mm"),
  height = nrow(pol_mat) * unit(5, "mm"),
  column_title = "Protein polarity of FMC63+ CD8 T cells",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold")
)

draw(ht_pol, merge_legend = TRUE)

pdf(here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "4B_polarity.pdf"), width = 12)
draw(ht_pol, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

png(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "4B_polarity.png"),
  width = 12,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  res = png_res
)
draw(ht_pol, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```


## panel B
- [ ] Clarify from which patient each cell comes from. Show at least one cell per patient
- [ ] Also make CD82 visualization from FMC63- cells

```{r}
#| label: fig4_b_fmc63_polarization
components_select_fmc <- PolarizationScores(
  data_t0t1,
  add_marker_counts = TRUE
) |>
  left_join(
    data_t0t1@meta.data |>
      select(component, celltype, patient, timepoint),
    by = "component"
  ) |>
  filter(
    celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+",
    marker == "FMC63",
    timepoint == "t0",
    morans_p_adjusted < 0.01,
    count > 100
  ) |>
  group_by(patient) |>
  slice_max(order_by = morans_z, n = 20) |>
  pull(component) |>
  unique()

data_cell_plot <- data_t0t1 |> subset(cells = components_select_fmc)

DefaultAssay(data_cell_plot) <- "mpxCells"
data_cell_plot <- data_cell_plot |>
  LoadCellGraphs(load_layouts = TRUE, force = TRUE) |>
  ComputeLayout(layout_method = "wpmds", dim = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig4_b_fmc63_polarization_plots

data_cell_plot_gi <- data_cell_plot

for (comp in components_select_fmc) {
  cg <- CellGraphs(data_cell_plot_gi)[[comp]]
  g <- CellGraphData(cg, "cellgraph")
  counts <- CellGraphData(cg, "counts")
  gi_mat <- local_G(g, counts, k = 4)
  gi_mat[gi_mat > quantile(gi_mat, 0.99)] <- quantile(gi_mat, 0.99)
  CellGraphData(cg, "counts") <- as(gi_mat, "dgCMatrix")
  CellGraphs(data_cell_plot_gi)[[comp]] <- cg
}

plot_markers <- c("FMC63", "CD82")

cell_labels <- data_cell_plot_gi@meta.data |>
  filter(component %in% components_select_fmc) |>
  select(component, patient) |>
  arrange(patient, component) |>
  group_by(patient) |>
  mutate(label = str_trunc(component, side = "right", width = 15)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(component, label) |>
  tibble::deframe()

cells_named <- setNames(
  components_select_fmc,
  cell_labels[components_select_fmc]
)

p_list <- lapply(plot_markers, function(m) {
  plots <- lapply(seq_along(cells_named), function(i) {
    Plot2DGraph(
      data_cell_plot_gi,
      cells = cells_named[[i]],
      layout_method = "wpmds",
      marker = m,
      colors = cherry_gradient(11),
      collect_scales = FALSE,
      node_size = 0.2
    ) +
      ggtitle(names(cells_named)[[i]]) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
  })
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 5)
})

p_list

pdf(
  here(
    "mpx",
    "results",
    "revised_figs",
    "cell_layout_cd8_cart_cells_t0_localG.pdf"
  ),
  width = 10,
  height = 10
)
for (p in p_list) {
  print(p)
}
dev.off()

png(
  here(
    "mpx",
    "results",
    "revised_figs",
    "cell_layout_cd8_cart_cells_t0_localG.png"
  ),
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  res = png_res
)
for (p in p_list) {
  print(p)
}
dev.off()
```

## panel C

```{r}
data_t0t1$component <- NULL


colocscores_dat <- ColocalizationScores(
  data_t0t1,
  meta_data_columns = c("sample", "donor", "celltype", "timepoint")
)

colocscores_dat$celltype_timepoint <- paste0(
  colocscores_dat$celltype,
  "_",
  colocscores_dat$timepoint
)

colocscores_summarized <- SummarizeProximityScores(
  colocscores_dat |>
    rename(join_count_z = pearson_z),
  group_vars = c("sample", "donor", "celltype", "timepoint"),
  proximity_metric = "join_count_z",
  summary_stat = "mean",
  include_missing_obs = T
) |>
  rename(mean_pearson_z = mean_join_count_z)
```


```{r}
#| label: fig4_c_fmc63_colocalization_heatmap

samples_plot <- colocscores_summarized$donor |> unique()
coloc_dat_plot <- list()
cd8t_markers <- unique(unlist(selected_markers[c(3, 4)]))


#' Prep data
coloc_dat_plot[["CD8 T"]] <- lapply(samples_plot, function(sample_select) {
  scores_sample <- colocscores_summarized |>
    filter(timepoint == "t0") |>
    filter(marker_1 %in% cd8t_markers, marker_2 %in% cd8t_markers) |>
    filter(celltype == "CD8 T", donor == sample_select) |>
    select(donor, marker_1, marker_2, mean_pearson_z)
  return(scores_sample)
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = donor, values_from = mean_pearson_z) |>
  mutate(
    mean_coloc_score = rowMeans(across(samples_plot), na.rm = TRUE),
    size_constant = 1
  )

coloc_dat_plot[["CD8 T FMC63+"]] <- lapply(
  samples_plot,
  function(sample_select) {
    scores_sample <- colocscores_summarized |>
      filter(timepoint == "t0") |>
      filter(marker_1 %in% cd8t_markers, marker_2 %in% cd8t_markers) |>
      filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+", donor == sample_select) |>
      select(donor, marker_1, marker_2, mean_pearson_z)
    return(scores_sample)
  }
) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = donor, values_from = mean_pearson_z) |>
  mutate(
    mean_coloc_score = rowMeans(across(samples_plot), na.rm = TRUE),
    size_constant = 1
  )

#' Plot for CAR- T cells
p1 <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
  coloc_dat_plot[["CD8 T"]],
  value_col = "mean_coloc_score",
  size_col = "size_constant",
  type = "dots",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  legend_range = c(-5, 5),
  size_range = c(1, 4.5)
) &
  labs(
    title = "FMC63-",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Mean\npearson Z\n(of donor mean)"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "none") &
  guides(size = "none")

p_build <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(p1)
m_order <- p_build$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x$get_labels()

#' Plot for CAR+ T cells
p2 <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
  coloc_dat_plot[["CD8 T FMC63+"]],
  value_col = "mean_coloc_score",
  size_col = "size_constant",
  marker_order = m_order,
  # clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  # clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  # clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_cols = F,
  type = "dots",
  legend_range = c(-5, 5),
  size_range = c(1, 4.5)
) &
  labs(
    title = "FMC63+",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Mean\npearson Z\n(of donor mean)"
  ) &
  # scale_y_discrete(position = "right", limits = rev(m_order)) & # Add this if marker labels should be on right side
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
  ) &
  guides(size = "none")

ggsave2(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "4C_cd8_fmc63_pos_t0.pdf"),
  p2,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 6.5
)
```

```{r}
fmc_coloc_data <- colocscores_summarized %>%
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+") |>
  filter(timepoint == tp_select) |>
  filter(marker_1 == "FMC63" | marker_2 == "FMC63") |>
  mutate(
    to = ifelse(marker_1 == "FMC63", marker_2, marker_1),
    from = ifelse(marker_2 == "FMC63", marker_2, marker_1)
  ) |>
  filter(to %in% markers_plot) |>
  select(to, mean_pearson_z, donor) |>
  mutate(
    patient = case_when(
      donor == "donor_32" ~ "Patient 1",
      donor == "donor_44" ~ "Patient 2",
      donor == "donor_50" ~ "Patient 3"
    ),
    marker = to
  )


fmc_coloc_per_donor_plot <- DifferentialBubblePlot(
  data = fmc_coloc_data |>
    mutate(patient = forcats::fct_rev(patient) |> as.character()),
  color_palette = colors,
  has_pvalues = FALSE,
  effect_cutoff = 0,
  group_var = "patient",
  size_range = 5,
  color_range = c(-5, 5),
  # cluster_rows = FALSE,
  effect_col = "mean_pearson_z"
) +
  labs(fill = "Mean\ncolocalization\n(pearson-z)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "cm")
  )
fmc_coloc_per_donor_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: mean-abundance
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 10

# Fetch abundance data for CD8 T FMC63+
abundance_fmc63_pos <- data_t0t1 |>
  subset(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+") |>
  FetchData(
    vars = c("donor", "timepoint", markers_selected),
    assay = "mpxCells",
    layer = "data"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    patient = case_when(
      donor == "donor_32" ~ "Patient 1",
      donor == "donor_44" ~ "Patient 2",
      donor == "donor_50" ~ "Patient 3",
      TRUE ~ donor
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(patient, timepoint) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(markers_selected), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create matrix (rows = patient_timepoint, cols = markers)
mat_abundance <- abundance_fmc63_pos |>
  unite("row_id", patient, timepoint, sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  select(-patient, -timepoint) |>
  as.matrix()

# Extract row metadata
row_meta <- data.frame(row_id = rownames(mat_abundance)) |>
  separate(row_id, into = c("patient", "timepoint"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE)

# Color function
lims_ab <- c(-5, 5)
col_fun_ab <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(lims_ab[1], lims_ab[2], length.out = 100),
  retro_palette(100)
)

# Row annotations
row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
  `Timepoint` = row_meta$timepoint,
  `Patient` = row_meta$patient,
  col = list(
    `Timepoint` = c(
      "t0" = "#CCCCCC",
      "t1" = "#8f8f8f",
      "t2" = "#666666",
      "t3" = "#383838"
    ),
    `Patient` = pal_patient
  ),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

# Heatmap
ht_ab <- Heatmap(
  mat_abundance,
  name = "Mean Abundance\n(CLR)",
  col = col_fun_ab,
  row_split = factor(row_meta$timepoint, levels = unique(row_meta$timepoint)), # levels = c("t0", "t1")),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  left_annotation = row_ann,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  row_title = NULL,
  width = ncol(mat_abundance) * unit(5, "mm"),
  height = nrow(mat_abundance) * unit(5, "mm"),
  column_title = "CD8 T FMC63+ Mean Abundance",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1)
)

ht_ab_drawn <- draw(ht_ab, merge_legend = TRUE)

marker_order_mean_abundance <- colnames(mat_abundance)
column_order_abundance <- ComplexHeatmap::column_order(ht_ab_drawn)
if (is.list(column_order_abundance)) {
  column_order_abundance <- unlist(column_order_abundance)
}
marker_order_mean_abundance <- marker_order_mean_abundance[
  column_order_abundance
]

pdf(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "5D_mean_abundance.pdf"),
  width = 12,
  height = 3
)
draw(ht_ab, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

png(

)
draw(ht_ab, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```

- [ ] Differential heatmap for both CD8T FMC63+ and CD8T FMC63- cells with asterisks for significance

```{r}
#| label: fig-5-daa-cd8t
daa_res <- RunDAA(
  data_t0t1 |> subset(celltype %in% c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T")),
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  reference = "t0",
  targets = "t1",
  group_vars = c("celltype", "donor")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-5-heatmap
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

daa_res_filtered <- daa_res |>
  filter(marker %in% markers_selected) |>
  mutate(
    patient = case_when(
      donor == "donor_32" ~ "Patient 1",
      donor == "donor_44" ~ "Patient 2",
      donor == "donor_50" ~ "Patient 3",
      TRUE ~ donor
    )
  )

# Prepare difference matrix (t1 vs t0)
mat_diff <- daa_res_filtered |>
  select(patient, celltype, marker, difference) |>
  unite("row_id", celltype, patient, sep = " | ") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = difference, values_fill = 0) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

# Prepare p_adj matrix for annotations
mat_padj <- daa_res_filtered |>
  select(patient, celltype, marker, p_adj) |>
  unite("row_id", celltype, patient, sep = " | ") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = p_adj, values_fill = 1) |>
  column_to_rownames("row_id") |>
  as.matrix()

marker_order_fig5 <- marker_order_mean_abundance[
  marker_order_mean_abundance %in% colnames(mat_diff)
]
mat_diff <- mat_diff[, marker_order_fig5, drop = FALSE]
mat_padj <- mat_padj[, marker_order_fig5, drop = FALSE]

# Ensure matching dimensions and order
mat_padj <- mat_padj[rownames(mat_diff), colnames(mat_diff)]

# Create significance matrix
sig_mat <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(mat_padj), ncol = ncol(mat_padj))
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.05] <- "*"
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.01] <- "**"
sig_mat[mat_padj < 0.001] <- "***"

# Define row splits and annotations
row_meta <- data.frame(row_id = rownames(mat_diff)) |>
  separate(
    row_id,
    into = c("celltype", "patient"),
    sep = " \\| ",
    remove = FALSE
  )

# Colors
lims <- round(max(abs(mat_diff), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.8, 0)
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(-lims, lims, length.out = 100),
  retro_palette(100)
)

row_ann <- rowAnnotation(
  `Cell type` = row_meta$celltype,
  `Patient` = row_meta$patient,
  col = list(
    `Cell type` = c("CD8 T FMC63+" = "#4A0180", "CD8 T" = "#AD5BCD"),
    `Patient` = pal_patient
  ),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  annotation_name_rot = 45,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_diff,
  name = "Difference\n(t1 vs t0)",
  col = col_fun,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = seq(-lims, lims, by = 2), # explicit tick marks
    labels = as.character(seq(-lims, lims, by = 2)),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm")
  ),
  row_split = factor(row_meta$celltype, levels = c("CD8 T FMC63+", "CD8 T")),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  left_annotation = row_ann,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  width = ncol(mat_diff) * unit(5, "mm"),
  height = nrow(mat_diff) * unit(5, "mm"),
  row_title = NULL,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j] != "") {
      grid.text(
        sig_mat[i, j],
        x,
        y,
        vjust = 0.75,
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black")
      )
    }
  },
  column_title = "Differential Abundance (t1 vs t0)",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold")
)

draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)

pdf(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "5D_daa_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 12,
  height = 3
)
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

png(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "5D_daa_heatmap.png"),
  width = 12,
  height = 3,
  units = "in",
  res = png_res
)
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(size_constant = 1)

make_coloc_panel <- function(
  donor_id,
  timepoint_id,
  marker_order = NULL,
  cluster = FALSE
) {
  dat <- mean_coloc_fig6a |>
    filter(donor == donor_id, timepoint == timepoint_id)

  ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
    dat,
    value_col = "mean_coloc_score",
    size_col = "size_constant",
    marker_order = marker_order,
    cluster_rows = cluster,
    cluster_cols = cluster,
    type = "dots",
    legend_range = c(-5, 5),
    size_range = c(1, 4.5)
  ) &
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        case_when(
          donor_id == "donor_32" ~ "Patient 1",
          donor_id == "donor_50" ~ "Patient 3",
          TRUE ~ donor_id
        ),
        " ",
        toupper(timepoint_id)
      ),
      x = "",
      y = "",
      fill = "Mean\npearson Z"
    ) &
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8)) &
    guides(size = "none")
}

p6a_mean_scores
```

### Raw colocalization scores and dynamics

To further investigate marker dynamics between pre-infusion (t0) and post-infusion (t1), the raw colocalization scores (mean pearson Z) for FMC63 pairs are shown below. Rows (markers) are clustered to identify modules with similar behavior and annotated with a dynamics category:

- **shared changes**: Colocalization shifts in the same direction (increase or decrease) across all donors, or both donors exhibit the same sign flip (e.g., negative to positive).
- **donor-specific loss**: Colocalization changes from positive (t0) to negative (t1) in only a subset of donors.
- **donor-specific gain**: Colocalization changes from negative (t0) to positive (t1) in only a subset of donors.
- **mostly unchanged**: The magnitude of change between timepoints is minimal ($\Delta Z \le 0.5$) for the majority of donors.

```{r}
#| label: raw-coloc-scores

raw_coloc_fmc63 <- colocscores_summarized |>
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+") |>
  filter(donor != "donor_44") |>
  filter(marker_1 == "FMC63" | marker_2 == "FMC63") |>
  mutate(
    marker_non_fmc63 = if_else(marker_1 == "FMC63", marker_2, marker_1)
  ) |>
  filter(marker_non_fmc63 %in% markers_selected)

if (nrow(raw_coloc_fmc63) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No raw FMC63-pair rows found in colocscores_summarized after filtering."
  )
}

raw_coloc_plot <- raw_coloc_fmc63 |>
  select(donor, timepoint, marker_non_fmc63, mean_pearson_z) |>
  group_by(donor, timepoint, marker_non_fmc63) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pearson_z = mean(mean_pearson_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

donor_levels_raw <- raw_coloc_plot$donor |>
  unique() |>
  sort()
timepoint_levels_raw <- c("t0", "t1")

raw_coloc_plot <- raw_coloc_plot |>
  filter(donor %in% donor_levels_raw, timepoint %in% timepoint_levels_raw) |>
  mutate(
    donor = factor(donor, levels = donor_levels_raw),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoint_levels_raw),
    col_id = paste(donor, timepoint, sep = "__")
  )

mat_raw_coloc <- raw_coloc_plot |>
  select(marker_non_fmc63, col_id, mean_pearson_z) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = col_id,
    values_from = mean_pearson_z,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("marker_non_fmc63") |>
  as.matrix()

ordered_col_ids_raw <- as.vector(outer(
  donor_levels_raw,
  timepoint_levels_raw,
  paste,
  sep = "__"
))
ordered_col_ids_raw <- ordered_col_ids_raw[
  ordered_col_ids_raw %in% colnames(mat_raw_coloc)
]
mat_raw_coloc <- mat_raw_coloc[, ordered_col_ids_raw, drop = FALSE]

col_meta_raw <- tibble(col_id = colnames(mat_raw_coloc)) |>
  separate(
    col_id,
    into = c("donor", "timepoint"),
    sep = "__",
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    donor = factor(donor, levels = donor_levels_raw),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoint_levels_raw)
  )

# Row-level dynamics annotation between t0 and t1 on a per-donor basis
change_threshold <- 0.5
row_dynamics <- apply(mat_raw_coloc, 1, function(x) {
  vals <- setNames(as.numeric(x), colnames(mat_raw_coloc))
  deltas <- c()
  n_pairs <- 0
  n_loss <- 0
  n_gain <- 0

  for (d in donor_levels_raw) {
    t0_key <- paste(d, "t0", sep = "__")
    t1_key <- paste(d, "t1", sep = "__")
    if (t0_key %in% names(vals) && t1_key %in% names(vals)) {
      t0_val <- vals[[t0_key]]
      t1_val <- vals[[t1_key]]
      deltas <- c(deltas, t1_val - t0_val)
      n_pairs <- n_pairs + 1

      is_loss <- t0_val > 0 && t1_val < 0
      is_gain <- t0_val < 0 && t1_val > 0
      n_loss <- n_loss + as.integer(is_loss)
      n_gain <- n_gain + as.integer(is_gain)
    }
  }

  if (length(deltas) == 0) {
    return("mostly unchanged")
  }

  mostly_unchanged <- mean(abs(deltas) <= change_threshold) >= 0.67
  shared_up <- mean(deltas >= change_threshold) >= 0.67
  shared_down <- mean(deltas <= -change_threshold) >= 0.67

  shared_loss <- n_pairs > 0 && n_loss == n_pairs
  shared_gain <- n_pairs > 0 && n_gain == n_pairs
  donor_specific_loss <- n_loss > 0 && n_loss < n_pairs
  donor_specific_gain <- n_gain > 0 && n_gain < n_pairs

  # Partial donor sign flips must be labeled donor-specific.
  if (donor_specific_loss && !donor_specific_gain) {
    return("donor-specific loss")
  }
  if (donor_specific_gain && !donor_specific_loss) {
    return("donor-specific gain")
  }
  if (donor_specific_loss && donor_specific_gain) {
    return("shared changes")
  }

  # Shared changes are only assigned when all donors show the same flip behavior,
  # or when directional changes are shared without sign flips.
  if (shared_loss || shared_gain) {
    return("shared changes")
  }
  if ((shared_up || shared_down) && n_loss == 0 && n_gain == 0) {
    return("shared changes")
  }
  if (mostly_unchanged) {
    return("mostly unchanged")
  }
  return("mostly unchanged")
})

row_dyn_df <- data.frame(
  marker = rownames(mat_raw_coloc),
  dynamic = factor(
    row_dynamics,
    levels = c(
      "mostly unchanged",
      "shared changes",
      "donor-specific loss",
      "donor-specific gain"
    )
  )
)

row_ann_raw <- rowAnnotation(
  Pattern = row_dyn_df$dynamic,
  col = list(
    Pattern = c(
      "mostly unchanged" = "#D9D9D9",
      "shared changes" = "#6BAED6",
      "donor-specific loss" = "#F46D43",
      "donor-specific gain" = "#ccd174ff"
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

lims_raw_coloc <- 3

col_fun_raw_coloc <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-lims_raw_coloc, 0, lims_raw_coloc),
  c("#233C62", "white", "#931b58")
)

ht_raw_coloc <- Heatmap(
  mat_raw_coloc,
  name = "Mean\npearson Z",
  col = col_fun_raw_coloc,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_split = col_meta_raw$donor,
  column_title_rot = 90,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  column_labels = toupper(as.character(col_meta_raw$timepoint)),
  row_title = NULL,
  width = ncol(mat_raw_coloc) * unit(5, "mm"),
  height = nrow(mat_raw_coloc) * unit(5, "mm"),
  left_annotation = row_ann_raw,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
    at = c(-lims_raw_coloc, 0, lims_raw_coloc),
    labels = c(-lims_raw_coloc, 0, lims_raw_coloc)
  )
)

draw(ht_raw_coloc, merge_legend = TRUE)

pdf(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "6B_raw_coloc_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 5,
  height = 12
)
draw(ht_raw_coloc, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

png(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "6B_raw_coloc_heatmap.png"),
  width = 5,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  res = png_res
)
draw(ht_raw_coloc, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```


## Module scores


```{r}
#| label: seurat-module-scores

data_t0t1_coloc <- data_t0t1

DefaultAssay(data_t0t1_coloc) <- "mpxCells"
data_t0t1_coloc <- ColocalizationScoresToAssay(data_t0t1_coloc)
DefaultAssay(data_t0t1_coloc) <- "colocalization"

coloc_features_available <- rownames(
  GetAssayData(data_t0t1_coloc, assay = "colocalization", layer = "data")
)

pair_lookup <- colocscores_summarized |>
  filter(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+", donor != "donor_44") |>
  filter(marker_1 == "FMC63" | marker_2 == "FMC63") |>
  mutate(
    marker_non_fmc63 = if_else(marker_1 == "FMC63", marker_2, marker_1),
    pair_forward = paste(marker_1, marker_2, sep = "/"),
    pair_reverse = paste(marker_2, marker_1, sep = "/")
  ) |>
  select(marker_non_fmc63, pair_forward, pair_reverse) |>
  distinct()

find_coloc_features <- function(marker_name, lookup_tbl, available_features) {
  candidate_pairs <- lookup_tbl |>
    filter(marker_non_fmc63 == marker_name) |>
    select(pair_forward, pair_reverse) |>
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) |>
    unique()

  intersect(candidate_pairs, available_features)
}

module_markers <- split(row_dyn_df$marker, row_dyn_df$dynamic)
module_markers <- module_markers[lengths(module_markers) > 0]

module_features <- lapply(module_markers, function(marker_vec) {
  unique(unlist(lapply(
    marker_vec,
    find_coloc_features,
    lookup_tbl = pair_lookup,
    available_features = coloc_features_available
  )))
})
module_features <- module_features[lengths(module_features) > 0]

if (length(module_features) == 0) {
  stop("No colocalization assay features matched the FMC63-pair modules.")
}

module_feature_tbl <- tibble(
  dynamic = rep(names(module_features), lengths(module_features)),
  feature = unlist(module_features, use.names = FALSE)
)

data_t0t1_coloc <- AddModuleScore(
  object = data_t0t1_coloc,
  features = unname(module_features),
  assay = "colocalization",
  slot = "data",
  name = "coloc_module_",
  ctrl = 100
)

score_cols <- paste0("coloc_module_", seq_along(module_features))
module_name_map <- tibble(
  dynamic = names(module_features),
  score_col = score_cols
)

module_scores_long <- data_t0t1_coloc |>
  subset(celltype == "CD8 T FMC63+" & donor != "donor_44") |>
  FetchData(vars = c("sample", "donor", "timepoint", score_cols)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(score_cols),
    names_to = "score_col",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  left_join(module_name_map, by = "score_col")

# Aggregate by sample/timepoint to reduce pseudo-replication in donor tests
module_scores_summary <- module_scores_long |>
  group_by(donor, sample, timepoint, dynamic) |>
  summarise(module_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

module_stats <- module_scores_summary |>
  group_by(dynamic, timepoint) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ {
      donors <- sort(unique(.x$donor))
      if (length(donors) != 2) {
        return(tibble(
          donor_1 = NA_character_,
          donor_2 = NA_character_,
          p_value = NA_real_
        ))
      }

      x <- .x$module_score[.x$donor == donors[1]]
      y <- .x$module_score[.x$donor == donors[2]]
      p_val <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)

      tibble(donor_1 = donors[1], donor_2 = donors[2], p_value = p_val)
    }
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    p_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

donor_pairs <- combn(
  sort(unique(module_scores_summary$donor)),
  2,
  simplify = FALSE
)
max_abs_module <- max(abs(module_scores_summary$module_score), na.rm = TRUE)
if (max_abs_module == 0) {
  max_abs_module <- 1
}
y_lim_module <- max_abs_module * 1.2

p_module <- ggplot(
  module_scores_summary,
  aes(x = donor, y = module_score, fill = donor)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", width = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(dynamic ~ timepoint, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("donor_32" = "#7B98C1", "donor_50" = "#CB73A8")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-y_lim_module, y_lim_module)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Module score (sample-level mean)")

max_abs_module_cell <- max(abs(module_scores_long$score), na.rm = TRUE)
if (max_abs_module_cell == 0) {
  max_abs_module_cell <- 1
}
y_lim_module_cell <- max_abs_module_cell * 1.2


p_module_cells <- ggplot(
  module_scores_long,
  aes(x = donor, y = score, color = donor)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7, trim = TRUE) +
  # geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  ggforce::geom_sina(
    scale = "width",
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.15,
    maxwidth = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(color = donor),
    fun = median,
    geom = "crossbar",
    size = 0.3,
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(dynamic ~ timepoint, scales = "fixed") +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = donor_pairs,
    test = "wilcox.test",
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    step_increase = 0.1,
    textsize = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("donor_32" = "#7B98C1", "donor_50" = "#CB73A8")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-y_lim_module_cell, y_lim_module_cell)) +
  lims(y = c(-10, 14)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Module score (single-cell)")

timepoint_pairs <- list(c("t0", "t1"))

p_module_time <- ggplot(
  module_scores_summary |>
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("t0", "t1"))),
  aes(x = timepoint, y = module_score, fill = timepoint)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", width = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(dynamic ~ donor, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("t0" = "#7B98C1", "t1" = "#CB73A8")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-y_lim_module, y_lim_module)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Module score (sample-level mean)")

p_module_time_cells <- ggplot(
  module_scores_long |>
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("t0", "t1"))),
  aes(x = timepoint, y = score, color = timepoint)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7, trim = TRUE) +
  ggforce::geom_sina(
    scale = "width",
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.15,
    maxwidth = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(color = timepoint),
    fun = median,
    geom = "crossbar",
    size = 0.3,
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(dynamic ~ donor, scales = "fixed") +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = timepoint_pairs,
    test = "wilcox.test",
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    step_increase = 0.1,
    textsize = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("t0" = "#7B98C1", "t1" = "#CB73A8")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-y_lim_module_cell, y_lim_module_cell)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Module score (single-cell)")

ggsave2(
  here(
    "mpx",
    "results",
    "revised_figs",
    "6C_module_scores_donor_timepoint.pdf"

ggsave2(
  here("mpx", "results", "revised_figs", "6C_module_scores_single_cell.pdf"),

ggsave2(
```
